title: Native QA progress overlay
purpose: Prevent bounded native module work from being repeated blindly while preserving the original all-unverified inventory and history.
coverage_policy: Only named evidence records are mapped. Representative values and behavior do not promote untested controls or arbitrary values to tested.

module_progress.control_scope: 14 direct controls plus recorded Advanced/Visibility/condition behavior
limits: Representative values only; arbitrary values, all fonts/styles, Motion, Hover and Focus remain open.
Condition-control label fix still requires candidate82 native verification.

module_progress.control_scope: 8 direct controls plus recorded Advanced/Visibility/condition behavior
limits: Four separator variants and representative responsive values are covered; arbitrary row counts/values, Motion, Hover and Focus remain open.
Condition-control label fix still requires candidate82 native verification.

module_progress.control_scope: 10 direct controls plus recorded Advanced/State/Visibility behavior
limits: All 35 exported icon choices are recorded, but link modes are not all-device reload proof and Hover/Focus proof is Desktop-specific.
Site checks recovery is separate and not Icon coverage.

module_progress.control_scope: 14 direct controls plus recorded Advanced/Visibility/condition behavior and separate padding/layout follow-up
limits: Edge rows and conditional-controls-off proof are Mobile-only.
Position, max-width, overflow, shared Motion/State and condition-label native verification remain open.
Padding fix accepted locally and in deployed Cloud/installed WordPress; broader module/common control combinations remain open.

module_progress.control_scope: Recorded content/language/copy/line/wrap/style/token/responsive/Advanced/Visibility/condition cases and separate padding/layout follow-up
limits: Eight languages and representative values are covered; arbitrary values/units/fonts/colors, common Motion/State/Hover/Focus and runtime-generated controls remain open.
Padding fix accepted locally and in deployed Cloud/installed WordPress; broader module/common control combinations remain open.

pending_next_checks: Collection list L01–L08: initial source and repeated Heading binding/empty/no-source reload proof exists locally; remaining cases are open.
Per-module condition-label checks beyond the generic accepted82 labels.
Table position, max-width and overflow controls.
Common Motion, Hover/Focus, dynamic component and full customer-flow combinations outside named records.
broad_open_areas: All builder modules outside the five mapped modules.
Shared Style/common controls and Advanced groups across modules.
Motion, transition, animation, duration, delay, easing and once controls.
Hover and keyboard Focus state controls and state-specific DOM/computed output.
Exhaustive Desktop/Tablet/Mobile plus state combinations beyond named cases.
Arbitrary values, units, fonts, colors, token sets and named styles.
Runtime-generated and conditional inspector controls not represented by named cases.
CMS bindings, source selectors and dynamic collection-field controls.
Dynamic component properties, component instances, variants and library workflows.
Collection contexts, repeated items, pagination and CMS rendering.
Full create/edit/save/reload flows for every module and setting family.
Physical devices, alternate browser engines, accessibility technology and keyboard-only workflows beyond recorded cases.
External integrations, roles, publishing, production/staging and recovery workflows.
do_not_claim: Do not convert a bounded case record into an all-values or all-controls pass.
Do not infer native coverage from DEF rows or unit tests alone.
Do not count the pre-fix padding blank-field observation as post-fix success.

release83.status: native accepted; fixtures restored; no production promotion
